title: Flight 19 and the lost PBY from Banana River
place_text: Banana River Naval Air Station (later Patrick AFB), Florida / Bermuda Triangle

tellings.quote: I talked to some of the guys that were in flight ops on that day

plain: In 1945 a group of Navy planes known as Flight 19 vanished off Florida, in the stretch of ocean called the Bermuda Triangle, and a PBY, a Navy flying boat sent out from Banana River Naval Air Station, was lost too. Greg Rogers, a former NASA doctor, says he talked to "some of the guys that were in flight ops on that day" and tells the story from what they told him. It matters because it is one of the founding mysteries of the Bermuda Triangle.
